narrative: Round 24 targeted only bp35 L9 and tested the operator-specified missing-rung candidates through public env.step actions and public frame layers. The required 342-action prefix first replayed from a fresh environment to levels_completed=8, GameState.NOT_FINISHED (settled-frame sha256 375b7eddf99ae0a2ef41439fe15d92d2c8925b57720f3c6c833b9bb64711d2c0). A fresh camera registrar then re-derived the known checkpoints numerically: the 10-action ladder reaches rests 20.5, 14.5, 8.5, 2.5, -3.5, and -9.5 with final camera -48. Candidate A, against-gravity carry: after reversing to DOWN gravity at rest -9.5, directly-above clicks were tested at three world rests and several distances. At -9.5 an above click hit and safely carved the door (32 aligned cells) but did not carry; at +2.5 and +8.5 direct-above clicks changed 0 cells and moved 0 rows. Only the with-gravity below click carried downward (+6, from +2.5 to +8.5). Lateral-then-vertical variants changed remote structure topology but never mounted the player upward. Candidate B, multi-column geometry: remote-first, base-first, one- and two-upper-segment, gravity-cycle, left-column, and right-column constructions were tested. Remote-first growth was inert until a base existed; base-first remote growth changed 120 aligned cells but blocked entry; sequential riding reproduced only the ordinary +2.5 -> -3.5 -> -9.5 ladder; the right column crushed at -3.5. A 25-point fresh-env click sweep around the final carry (x=25..29, y=31..35) produced one unique outcome: all 25 were alive, 12 layers, dy=-6, rest=-9.5, camera=-48. Candidate C, door timing: the synchronous public step API exposes no opportunity to inject another action during a returned animation. The strongest back-to-back order was therefore measured: carve door 1 safely while DOWN, then flip UP while parked in the already-open column. It still produced the exact 47-layer fatal flight, last visible at world -38.0, the flight-start view top. Clicking the carved door cell again and both cap locations changed 0 cells, so the gap cannot be refilled as a shelf. ACTION7 exactly restored all 32 door cells (21 color-14 plus 11 cap/accent cells) and made the subsequent UP flip safe, but it also reclosed the passage and left the player at -9.5. Candidates D and E remained unreachable: no live player entered world rows -49..-53, so the alleged -51 floor is still unverified live; the color-12 row never entered a live settled view and was not clicked. Candidate F remains honestly inconclusive: deliberate DOWN transitions measured +12 drops (38.5 -> 50.5 and -9.5 -> +2.5), both surviving, but no genuinely unsupported >20-row downward flight was found, so bottom-edge symmetry was not claimed. The best surviving rest remains world -9.5; no rest in [-48,-13], no level 9, and no win were observed.
novel_mechanics_found: ACTION7 is a cell-exact reversible door undo in this context: a safe DOWN-gravity door carve changed exactly 32 aligned world cells over x=13..17, y=-18..-12 (14>10:21, 3>10:4, 5>10:7); ACTION7 immediately restored exactly the inverse transitions (10>14:21, 10>3:4, 10>5:7) without moving the player from world -9.5.

Door-gap refill is impossible under the tested safe timing: after carving door 1 while DOWN, repeat clicks at the exact empty door cell and at the carved top and bottom cap coordinates each changed 0 aligned cells. The following UP flip remained a 47-layer viewport-top death.

Final-carry click coordinates are hitbox-invariant over the tested 5x5 region: all 25 fresh-env offsets x=25..29/y=31..35 produced exactly dy=-6 and rest -9.5; no partial, diagonal, or taller carry exists in that hitbox.

Against-gravity structure clicks do not carry: at DOWN-gravity rests +2.5 and +8.5, direct-above clicks moved 0 rows; the symmetric below click carried +6 in the gravity direction. Above clicks at rest -9.5 select the door, not structure.
bounded_negative_results: A / against-gravity carry: direct-above at world rests -9.5, +2.5, and +8.5; lateral-then-vertical at two columns; and one-cell-farther above clicks produced no upward player displacement. The only non-inert -9.5 above click carved a door.

B / multi-column geometries: simultaneous prebuild trapped the player at x~33; sequential remote-first/base-first constructions either blocked entry or converged to ordinary rests -3.5 and -9.5; a right-column climb crushed at -3.5. The 25-offset final-carry sweep had exactly one outcome and no rest above -9.5.

C / door timing: DOWN carve followed immediately by UP flip in the open player column died after 47 layers at world -38.0, exactly the active view top. Re-clicking the gap/caps was inert. ACTION7 only recloses the door; it does not create a rung.
D / -51 floor: untested live because no legal trajectory entered world rows -49..-53. No inference about floor presence is promoted from overview/death frames.
E / color-12 toggle row: not reached and not interacted with; no semantics claimed.
F / bottom boundary: two deliberate DOWN transitions survived 12-row drops, but neither was the requested unsupported >20-row drop. Symmetric bottom-kill versus follow behavior remains unresolved.
No new rest above world -9.5, no new level, and no game clear.
next_leads: The frontier remains exactly the round-23 arithmetic: obtain any surviving rest in world rows -13..-48 in a door/gap column. All requested carry, split-column, door-refill/timing, and off-center-click variants are now bounded nulls.

A future bottom-boundary test must first identify a public path to a genuinely unsupported downward landing more than 20 world rows below the flight-start camera; the two +12 transitions here are positive survival controls, not a symmetry answer.

If a new mechanism ever yields a rest at or above -12.5, immediately trace entry into rows -49..-53 to verify the proposed -51 floor, then inspect/click the color-12 row only after it becomes live-visible.
